label: Resources
description: A unit-wide gauge that shapes how the unit plays. A card has at most one.

terms.label: Shared heat
terms.description: Weapons and abilities add heat to one gauge; overheating shuts the unit down briefly.

terms.label: Energy pool
terms.description: One pool feeds weapons, shields and abilities, so the player chooses what to spend it on.

terms.label: Fuel
terms.description: Flight or boost time drains a gauge that refills on the ground or at a pad.

terms.label: Limited ammo
terms.description: Total ammo is finite; a supporter, a pickup or the base refills it.

terms.label: Kill charge
terms.description: A meter filled by kills or damage dealt powers an upgrade or an ultimate.
